block.marovgribs.hopcap.desc: Tosses whoever steps on it into the air. Eat it: Jump Boost II for 30 s.
block.marovgribs.glowcap.desc: Glows and grows in caves, even on bare stone. Eat it: Night Vision for 60 s.
block.marovgribs.puffball.desc: Puffs blinding spores at anyone who walks into it. Sneak to pass safely. Eat it: Slow Falling.
block.marovgribs.fly_agaric.desc: Eat it: Strength II, but also nausea and poison. Agaric Guards look after these.
item.marovgribs.spore_bomb.desc: Throw it: the spore cloud blinds, slows and weakens.
item.marovgribs.marov_stew.desc: The best of all four mushrooms, minus the poison.
block.marovgribs.chanterelle.desc: A mushroom with a fox's tail. Eat it: Speed. Foxes can't resist it, and something odd happens when one takes it...
block.marovgribs.parasol_sprout.desc: Bone meal grows it into a huge parasol mushroom. Undead hide in its shade from the sun.
block.marovgribs.marov_mycelium.desc: Spreads over dirt. Mushrooms on it spread five times faster.
item.marovgribs.russula.desc: Grind it in a mortar for two dyes of its colour.
item.marovgribs.mortar.desc: Put it in the crafting grid with a russula or a coloured mushroom to grind dye.
item.marovgribs.cordyceps.desc: Grows on zombies. Eat it: Haste and Speed.
item.marovgribs.death_cap_hat.desc: The boss's own cap. Poison and spore clouds can't touch you.
